================================================================================
New with expression operands
================================================================================

package main

func main() {
	a := new(42)
	b := new(int64(-64))
	c := new("NewConnContextKey")
	d := new(secretType(secretValue))
	e := new([]int{1, 2})
	f := new(x + 1)
}

================================================================================
New and make with type operands
================================================================================

func main() {
	a := new(T)
	b := new(pkg.T)
	c := new([]int)
	d := new(G[int])
	e := new(*T)
	f := make([]int, n, 2*n)
	g := make(map[string]int)
}
